## Romantic 3-Course Dinner for Two
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg

Elegant, beginner-friendly, and built to stay under **$45 total**. The menu avoids seafood and mushrooms, and the cooking order is arranged so everything lands on the table within **90 minutes**.

## Menu Plan and Budget

| Course | Dish | Why it works | Est. cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| Appetizer | Tomato, cucumber, and feta salad with lemon-herb dressing | Fresh, colorful, low-effort, restaurant-style | $8 |
| Main | Garlic-butter chicken with roasted baby potatoes and green beans | Classic, impressive, and hard to mess up | $24 |
| Dessert | Strawberry mascarpone parfaits with crushed cookies | No-bake, pretty, and fast | $11 |

**Estimated total:** **$43**

## Cooking Order for a 90-Minute Finish
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/clock.svg

### 0:00–0:10 — Start dessert and prep
- Wash and slice strawberries.
- Mix mascarpone with a little honey and vanilla.
- Crush cookies and set dessert cups aside.
- Preheat oven to **425°F / 220°C**.

### 0:10–0:20 — Get the main into the oven
- Halve baby potatoes and toss with oil, salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
- Spread potatoes on a sheet pan and roast first.
- Trim green beans and season lightly.
- Pat chicken dry and season both sides.

### 0:20–0:35 — Prep appetizer and finish main prep
- Chop tomatoes, cucumber, and herbs.
- Whisk lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper for the salad.
- Turn potatoes once.
- Add chicken to a second pan or push potatoes aside if using one pan.

### 0:35–0:55 — Roast and cook
- Roast chicken until done, basting once with butter and garlic near the end.
- Add green beans to the oven for the last 10–12 minutes, or sauté them quickly in a pan.
- Toss the salad just before serving.

### 0:55–1:10 — Plate the appetizer and main
- Serve salad first.
- Plate chicken with potatoes and green beans.
- Rest chicken for 5 minutes before slicing.

### 1:10–1:20 — Finish dessert
- Layer cookie crumbs, mascarpone cream, and strawberries in glasses.
- Chill briefly if you have time, or serve immediately.

## Recipe Details

### Appetizer: Tomato, Cucumber, and Feta Salad
- **Ingredients:** cherry tomatoes, cucumber, feta, olive oil, lemon, parsley or basil, salt, pepper
- **Method:** Toss everything together right before serving.
- **Elegant touch:** Serve in small bowls and finish with a few herb leaves on top.

### Main: Garlic-Butter Chicken with Roasted Potatoes and Green Beans
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/egg-fried.svg
- **Ingredients:** 2 chicken breasts or 4 small thighs, baby potatoes, green beans, butter, garlic, olive oil, lemon, salt, pepper, paprika
- **Method:** Roast potatoes first, then cook chicken until juicy and golden. Add green beans near the end.
- **Elegant touch:** Slice chicken on a slight diagonal and spoon pan juices over the top.

### Dessert: Strawberry Mascarpone Parfaits
- **Ingredients:** strawberries, mascarpone, honey, vanilla, whipped cream or milk, crushed shortbread or graham crackers
- **Method:** Sweeten the mascarpone lightly, then layer with strawberries and crumbs.
- **Elegant touch:** Use clear glasses so the layers show.

## Shopping List Within Budget

- Chicken, 1 to 1.5 lb: $10–$14
- Baby potatoes: $4
- Green beans: $3
- Cherry tomatoes: $4
- Cucumber: $2
- Feta: $4
- Strawberries: $4
- Mascarpone or cream cheese: $5
- Cookies or graham crackers: $3
- Lemon, garlic, herbs, olive oil, butter: $4–$6
